name: compute-fork
description: A fork of compute. One interface to every decentralized compute market, and a way to actually use what you rent. Targon and Lium (Bittensor SN4/SN51), Akash, Vast.ai, Clore, Nosana, Cathedral confidential TDX, Prime Intellect, Polaris, Hyperbolic, Shadeform and your own docker hosts, normalized to one offer/instance shape priced in USD/hr and addressed as provider:ref. Then compute/deploy turns a rented box into a mod protocol node: it installs mod core over the same transport it rents with, and the browser console gets a shell, the node's module list, and a call button for every function on them — no port has to be open on the box. Twenty-one MCP tools replace eleven provider APIs. BYOK throughout: every call spends the caller's own credits on their own provider account, and the no-KYC crypto-native markets come first.
backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib) — no dependencies

providers.targon: Bittensor SN4 GPUs — TAO credits, no KYC
providers.lium: Bittensor SN51 GPU marketplace — no KYC
providers.akash: Cosmos deployment market — AKT/USDC, permissionless, wallet-signed
providers.vast: open GPU marketplace — crypto funding, no KYC
providers.clore: blockchain GPU marketplace — CLORE/BTC/USDT, public catalog, no KYC
providers.cathedral: confidential Intel TDX / CC-GPU with signed receipts
providers.prime: Prime Intellect broker across decentralized + traditional clouds
providers.hyperbolic: open marketplace of independently operated GPUs — crypto or card
providers.shadeform: multi-cloud aggregator — the fiat benchmark, not no-KYC
providers.local: your own docker hosts, billed on-chain (COMPUTE_FORK_LOCAL=1)

endpoints.mods: GET /mods?mod=&compare=&sample=&gpu=&max_usd_hr= — the same markets read through the sibling modules that front them (targon, lium, cathedral), each against the direct lane
endpoints.rent: POST /rent {id, hours, confirm, name, image, ssh_key}
endpoints.identity: GET /identity — the SSH public key this module rents with
endpoints.deploy: POST /nodes/deploy {id|instance|ssh|docker, name, hours, confirm, image, profile, ports} — rent or adopt a box, then install mod on it
endpoints.node_push: POST /node/push {node, mod} — send a local module to the node
endpoints.node_tunnel: POST /node/tunnel {node, port} — bring a port back to this browser
endpoints.node_rm: POST /node/rm {node, release} — release=1 also stops the rental

byok.rule: every call spends the caller's own credits — this module holds no house key and no wallet

env.COMPUTE_FORK_CONFIRM_USD: spend guard: estimates above this need confirm=true (default 0.50)
env.COMPUTE_FORK_FANOUT_TIMEOUT: seconds any one provider gets during a fan-out (default 30)
env.COMPUTE_FORK_LOCAL: 1 to include your own docker hosts as a provider
env.TARGON_API_KEY / LIUM_API_KEY / VAST_API: per-provider keys, checked before the keystore
env.COMPUTE_FORK_MOD_HOST: host the sibling modules answer on (default 127.0.0.1)
env.COMPUTE_FORK_MOD_TIMEOUT: seconds a sibling module gets in the mod lane (default 12)
env.COMPUTE_FORK_TEST_LIVE: 0 to skip the tests that touch live catalogs

mod_lane.what: the markets that also run as their own modules on this box, read through those modules and compared with the direct-to-upstream lane
mod_lane.rule: a view only: ids are the upstream's own and renting still goes direct

nodes.what: a rented box, bootstrapped into a mod protocol container and driven from here
nodes.transports: docker exec (here or over SSH), SSH, or the provider's own exec API
nodes.install: mod/core streamed from this checkout as a tar — no git on the box, no clone from GitHub
nodes.control: modctl.py on the node speaks JSON over the same transport, so nothing has to listen on a public interface
nodes.ssh_key: ~/.mod/compute-fork/id_ed25519 — generated on first need, public half handed to markets at rent time

auth.open: info, health, providers, search, offer, quote, mods, tools — reading a market spends nothing
auth.byok: instances, status, logs, balance, keys — allowed when the caller brings their own provider key
auth.owner: rent, stop, exec, raw, set_key and every /node route
auth.proof: Authorization: Bearer `m compute-fork/token`, or a request from localhost that did not pass through the gateway
